## queue-2026-10-30

Reviewed **101 sources** previously marked **95 needs-review**, **6 reference-only**. Current outcomes: **67 listed**, **20 reference-only**, **14 needs-review**, **0 excluded**.

The review followed original publisher pages and available worksheets, used official-site search for moved or blocked pages, and used a browser where script-rendered content hid useful evidence. No accounts were created, no paid courses were purchased, no entire video course was watched, and no project was built. `sample-reviewed` applies only where complete representative written instructions were inspected; source checks and access attempts are labeled separately.
